title: The 1952 Photograph
caption: A thing remembers who was taken out of it.

captions.text: The edges are wavy: that's how the studio trimmed them. The paper is warm from the lamp.
The scissors followed the outline slowly. Only at the collar did the hand shake.
On the shoulder of the woman in white, someone else's hand remains.
